meta.name: scope-check
meta.description: 通过将当前范围与原始计划进行对比，分析功能或 Sprint 的范围蔓延（Scope Creep）。标记新增项，量化膨胀程度，并推荐裁剪方案。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对比计划与实际范围，识别并量化范围蔓延
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常因需求膨胀导致项目延期
copy.tagline_en: Compare actual scope with original plan to identify and quantify scope creep
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face project delays due to scope creep

howto.what: 当你提供功能名称或Sprint编号时，Claude会读取相关设计文档、Git日志和代码，对比原始计划与当前实现，生成范围检测报告，标记新增项、量化膨胀百分比，并给出裁剪建议和风险评估。
howto.when: 当你直接询问某个功能或Sprint的范围检查时触发，例如说出功能名或Sprint编号。

say.text: 帮我检查‘登录功能’的范围蔓延情况。
say.note: Claude会读取设计文档和代码并生成报告。
Claude会对比Sprint计划与实际进展。

howto.what_en: When you provide a feature name or sprint number, Claude reads design docs, Git logs, and code to compare the original plan with the current implementation, generating a scope check report that marks additions, quantifies expansion percentage, and recommends cuts with risk assessment.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you directly ask for a scope check on a specific feature or sprint, e.g., by naming the feature or sprint ID.

say_en.text: Check the scope creep of 'login feature'.
say_en.note: Claude will read design docs and code, then produce a report.

say_en.text: Run a scope check on Sprint 5.
say_en.note: Claude compares the sprint plan with actual progress.
